evidence.description: Unverified model assertion: spec.md written (210 lines) with FR-001..FR-004 encoding R01, including ValueError cases and [] for empty input
Unverified model assertion: checklist validation: 0 NEEDS CLARIFICATION markers; FR-001..FR-009 present and mapped to R01/R02/R03

falsification_tests: apply([{'op':'insert','document':{'a':[1]}}]) returns [] or a remove op contributes an ID to the result
apply([{'op':'update','doc_id':1,'values':{}}]) or apply('not-a-list') does not raise ValueError
claims.text: apply(operations) accepts a list of operation dicts; each op is {'op':'insert','document':dict} or {'op':'remove','doc_id':positive integer}; returns list of inserted document IDs in insertion order (removes add nothing); empty input returns []; unknown/malformed operations raise ValueError.

evidence.description: Unverified model assertion: spec.md written with FR-005..FR-007 encoding R02 (atomicity, missing-ID error, handle visibility); assumption A2 defers the missing-ID error type to plan

falsification_tests: Seed table, acquire handle via db.table('_default'), apply [insert, remove(missing ID)]; if the handle still shows the batch-inserted document, R02 is falsified
Apply a valid batch through the writer; if a previously acquired table handle does not show the inserted documents, R02 is falsified
claims.text: Batch application is atomic: validate and apply sequentially, but on any error restore the complete pre-batch default-table data; a remove targeting a missing ID is an error; previously acquired db.table('_default') handles reflect both success and rollback.

falsification_tests: Insert a nested document via apply(), then mutate the caller's original dict; if the stored document changes, R03 is falsified
Wrap a TinyDB with preexisting docs and perform ordinary inserts/reads before and after batch use; any behavior difference falsifies R03
claims.text: Ordinary TinyDB reads/writes and preexisting documents continue to work when BatchWriter wraps the instance; inserted and returned nested data must not alias the caller's input; mutating an operation after apply cannot mutate the database.
